craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta-adbhuta of rested-emitted — peace inside wonder; rest-and-publish song. Hidden-mirror speaks pure; once-from-flood kept. Rejected: (a) flood→flow → killed: flood is sudden. Read aloud: HID with-IN … PURE in-ACT.

lines: Hid within — boundless sense, own-self's mirror — knowing supreme —
once, from the flood — this mantra-knowing speech, pure in act.
